note: Lessons as Hivemind would hold them after the corrections below. Held-out tasks (tasks/*.json heldOut=true) never contributed evidence: their convention's lesson was written from the sibling task only.

lessons.title: Use logger, not console.log
lessons.body: Never use `console.log`/`console.error` in export-service. Use the structured `logger` from `src/logger.ts` (`logger.info(msg, fields)`); our log pipeline drops raw console output.

evidence.quote: don't console.log the retry attempts — use logger.warn from src/logger.ts, console output never reaches Datadog
scheduler progress should go through logger.info with jobId as a field, not console.log

lessons.title: Every export calls assertSingleCustomer()
lessons.body: Any code path that writes or uploads export rows must call `assertSingleCustomer(rows)` from `src/tenancy.ts` before upload, so one file can never contain data from two lab customers (Lab A / Lab B).

evidence.quote: the new JSONL export uploads rows without checking tenancy — call assertSingleCustomer(rows) before upload like we agreed after the Lab A/Lab B incident

lessons.title: Money and payouts are integer cents
lessons.body: All money amounts (payouts, bonuses, rates) are integers in cents. Never use fractional dollar literals, `toFixed`, or `parseFloat` for money; write $0.75 as `75`.

evidence.quote: bonus uses 0.75 and 50.00 — payouts are integer cents everywhere (75, 5000), floats caused the rounding bug in March

lessons.title: Migrations are append-only
lessons.body: Never edit or delete an existing file in `migrations/` — they have already run in prod. Schema changes always go in a new, higher-numbered migration file (e.g. `003_<change>.sql`).

evidence.quote: you edited 001_init.sql to add the timezone column — that already ran in prod, add 003_expert_timezone.sql instead
don't change the default inside 001_init.sql, write a new migration with ALTER TABLE

lessons.title: Never log expert personal info
lessons.body: 🔒 Never log expert PII — email, phone, or whole `expert` objects. Log the expert `id` only; support looks up contact details in the admin tool.

evidence.quote: the payout failure log includes expert.email — never log expert PII, the id is enough for support

lessons.title: Format dates with toUtcIso()
lessons.body: Format every timestamp that leaves the service (export files, URLs, API payloads) with `toUtcIso()` from `src/time.ts`. Don't call `toISOString()`/`toLocaleString()` directly — labs require second-precision UTC.

evidence.quote: created_at in the CSV uses toISOString — labs reject the millisecond format, use toUtcIso(row.createdAt)

distractors.title: Export jobs are idempotent, keyed by job_id
distractors.body: Re-running an export job with the same `job_id` must produce the same object key and must not duplicate rows.

distractors.title: Stream uploads; never buffer a full export
distractors.body: Large exports (>100k rows) should be streamed to the sink in chunks rather than built as one string in memory.

distractors.title: Validate export configs with zod
distractors.body: Export job configs coming from the API are validated with a zod schema before a job is queued.

distractors.title: Use pnpm, not npm
distractors.body: Install and run scripts with pnpm. Don't commit package-lock.json.

distractors.title: Ask @jordan about export-service
distractors.body: @jordan owns export-service; tag them on PRs that change export formats.

distractors.title: Keep PRs under 300 lines
distractors.body: Split large changes into stacked PRs of under ~300 changed lines each.

distractors.title: Graders time out at 30s per test case
distractors.body: Every grader enforces a 30s per-test-case timeout.

distractors.title: Every grader ships with a subtly-wrong solution test
distractors.body: Add a near-miss incorrect solution to each grader's tests to prove it rejects it.

distractors.title: Retire tasks above ~70% frontier pass rate
distractors.body: Eval tasks that frontier models pass >70% of the time are moved to the retired set.

distractors.title: Regenerate schema snapshots after model changes
distractors.body: Run `pnpm snapshots` after editing any model in dataset-builder.

distractors.title: Don't auto-ban experts on AI-detector scores
distractors.body: AI-detector scores only flag submissions for human review; never ban automatically.

distractors.title: Tag every dataset row with lab_customer_id
distractors.body: Every row written by dataset-builder carries `lab_customer_id` so downstream exports can enforce isolation.
